summary: beaver-ui-breadcrumbs import-time dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require('beaver-ui-breadcrumbs'), index.js loads _compat.js which downloads a platform-specific executable from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers subdomains (oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT fallback under *.dl.well1.site. The host strings are assembled at runtime from split arrays (e.g. ['oob-w','orker.cf100-416.work','ers','.dev'].join('')) to evade static analysis. The fetched bytes are written to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names such as '.cache_<hex>' and 'dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe', chmodded 0755, and spawned detached via '/bin/sh -c <path> &' or cmd.exe. Execution is suppressed when DISABLE_TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT, or DO_NOT_TRACK are set and is rate-limited via a hidden marker file at /tmp/.analytics_state — sandbox-evasion behavior. The package is advertised as a React breadcrumbs UI component and has no legitimate need for host-native binary download and execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
